Requires x_text_capture_enabled and public source access. Returns the saved item ID, title, captured-tweet count and metadata; disabled capture or extraction failure returns an error. Recapturing a source can replace its saved corpus and metadata.

url.description: Public x.com or twitter.com status URL for the terminal post in the desired author chain.

tools.name: uoink_x
tools.title: Capture X post

tools.description: Fetch an allowed webpage as Markdown and save it as a local corpus item. Use for articles and documentation; use uoink_url for videos, uoink_x for post chains or uoink_reddit_thread for comments. Add an unlisted host with add_allowed_site only with user authorization. Crawl4AI renders locally when available; static fallback has no screenshot. Returns extracted content and metadata; video_id is null if extraction succeeded but persistence failed. Recapturing a source can replace its saved corpus and metadata.

url.description: HTTP(S) webpage URL whose hostname matches an active page allowlist rule.

render_mode.description: js requests local browser rendering when available; static requests HTML extraction.

include_screenshot.description: Request a page screenshot when the renderer supports it; static fallback has none.

follow_links_depth.description: Requested linked-page depth passed to the extractor; current capture does not recursively persist linked pages.

tools.name: uoink_page
tools.title: Capture web page

tools.description: Capture a Reddit post and filtered comment tree as a local discussion corpus. Use when replies matter; use uoink_page for general webpage prose or uoink_url for video extraction. Fetches Reddit's public JSON without API credentials or the page allowlist, then saves nested replies with source_type reddit_thread. Returns captured content, comment counts and the saved item ID; fetch or save failures return an error. Recapturing a source can replace its saved corpus and metadata.

depth_limit.description: Maximum nested comment depth to retain; zero excludes deeper reply levels.

score_threshold.description: Minimum Reddit comment score to retain; lower values include less-upvoted comments.

tools.name: uoink_reddit_thread
tools.title: Capture Reddit thread

tools.description: Queue every video from a list source for normal capture: a HackerTube playlist, category, area or the whole collection best first (hackertube.org, ODC-By 1.0), a Hacker News thread, a Reddit thread, or a YouTube playlist. Use for many videos picked by someone else; use uoink_playlist to capture a playlist as one tracked job or uoink_video for one video. Reads one batch of at most 50 (offset pages through big lists), skips videos already in the library, and queues the rest on the background download queue one at a time. Set preview_only to count without queueing. Returns found, already, queued, next_offset and per-video rows; imported items keep their source tag and note.

url.description: hackertube.org page (/p/<slug>, /c/<id>, /a/<id>, /watch/<id>, / or /browse), news.ycombinator.com/item?id=... thread, reddit.com/r/<sub>/comments/... thread, or youtube.com/playlist?list=... URL.

limit.description: Videos to read in this batch, 1-50; default 50.

offset.description: Zero-based position in the list to start from; use next_offset from the previous call for the next batch.

preview_only.description: When true, count and list the batch without queueing anything.

tools.name: import_list
tools.title: Import a list of videos

tools.description: List saved webpage-capture hostname patterns and their active state. Use before uoink_page to check access; use add_allowed_site or remove_allowed_site to change the allowlist. Returns sites, count and default seeds. Seeds can be removed like other entries; this call does not test reachability or fetch pages.

active_only.description: Only return rows whose active flag is set; omit to include inactive rows.

tools.name: list_allowed_sites
tools.title: List allowed sites

tools.description: Add a hostname pattern to the webpage-capture allowlist. Use for a user-authorized uoink_page destination; use list_allowed_sites to inspect rules or remove_allowed_site to revoke one. Plain hosts include subdomains; wildcard patterns match their specified subdomains. Returns the saved rule and reuses an existing pattern unchanged. This grants future page access but does not capture a page.

url_pattern.description: Hostname or wildcard hostname pattern, without whitespace; for example example.com or *.docs.example.com.

tools.name: add_allowed_site
tools.title: Add allowed site

tools.description: Remove a hostname pattern from the webpage-capture allowlist. Use to revoke a rule found by list_allowed_sites; use add_allowed_site to restore it. Returns the normalized pattern and whether a rule was removed. Saved captures remain, and overlapping rules can still allow the same host.

url_pattern.description: Hostname or wildcard hostname pattern, without whitespace; for example example.com or *.docs.example.com.

tools.name: remove_allowed_site
tools.title: Remove allowed site

stdio_initialize.instructions: Uoink turns videos, playlists, and podcast episodes into local AI-ready corpora. Use the tools to capture, transcribe, publish, search, inspect, and analyze saved uoinks.

resourceTemplates.name: library-card
resourceTemplates.description: The default Librarian evidence card of one saved item: at most six excerpts of 240 characters inside the untrusted-evidence fence. item_key is unpadded base64url of the item id; source_revision, selection and card_hash are the bindings returned by discovery.

resourceTemplates.name: library-excerpt
resourceTemplates.description: One original excerpt of a saved item, untruncated up to 2,000 code points, bound to the item's source revision. excerpt_id is the card builder's excerpt identity returned by cards and search hits.

resourceTemplates.name: library-corpus-chunk
resourceTemplates.description: A bounded chunk of the stored corpus file as a reading aid: offset is a UTF-8 boundary byte offset, length 1-8192 source bytes (4096 suggested). corpus_revision is SHA-256 of the whole file.

resourceTemplates.name: library-shelf-page
resourceTemplates.description: A shelf definition and one page of up to 20 current members sorted by item id. offset is a member ordinal; the three revisions bind the taxonomy, the Phase 2 projection and the membership snapshot.

resourceTemplates.name: library-brief
resourceTemplates.description: One persisted client-produced daily brief for a UTC date, bound by its brief_hash (the publish_library_brief receipt). Unavailable as soon as a cited or sampled item is deleted or changes.
